record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, apply label smoothing of 0.05 to the existing full-catalog masked-item cross-entropy, uniformly over real item classes only. Mild smoothing may reduce overconfidence and improve generalization when ranking against sampled candidates. Preserve equal weighting of masked positions, existing masking and negative sampling, normalized tied embeddings, architecture, scoring, readout, optimizer, scheduler and batch/epoch settings. Keep one independently trained checkpoint per category.

category_rationales.rationale: Apply 0.05 label smoothing uniformly over real item classes in masked-item cross-entropy across all four datasets. This may reduce overconfidence while preserving equal masked-position weighting, normalized tied embeddings, masking, architecture and inference. Checkpoint shapes and the predictor remain compatible.
